caption: The drawing depicts a bowl and a plate, each decorated with a matching floral design. Both objects are primarily light beige or off-white in color. The bowl, shown in a perspective view from the side, features red-orange flowers with yellow centers and green leaves, arranged around the upper exterior. Small purple accents are interspersed between the flowers and leaves. The rim of the bowl is outlined in dark blue. Below the bowl, the plate is shown from a top-down perspective; it has the same floral and leaf pattern repeated around the border, with four flowers evenly spaced and accompanied by green and blue leaves along with small purple accents. The central part of the plate shows a circular area divided into three sections by faintly drawn lines. The plate's edge is also bordered by a dark blue line. Both items are set within a rectangular frame on a plain, off-white background. The artist’s name, "MUCH CLARKE," is written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Cup and Saucer
